Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience/ training.
Advanced degree or equivalent knowledge in Higher Education and Student Affairs Administration or related field.
Demonstrated experience planning, implementing and evaluating large­scale programs and events, preferably within a College or University setting.
Professional skills and experience with student leadership development and cultural competency development.
Demonstrated experience in multicultural, international, and/or social justice-related programming.
Ability to develop budgets. Financial record-keeping skills and experience sufficient to reconcile ledgers, maintain records, produce reports, and adhere to University policy.

Under the general supervision of the Associate Director for Academic and Co-Curricular Partnerships, the College Programs Coordinator (CPC) is responsible for supporting the implementation and advancement of the residential college model through the development of educational programs, traditions, student leadership opportunities, living-learning experiences, and community engagement initiatives that reinforce the unique identity and mission of each college community.

The CPC works collaboratively to support a pair of two colleges, and collaborates with college staff, students, faculty and campus partners to create an integrated student experience that connects learning outside of the classroom. Through intentional co-curricular design, development of signature programs, student leadership development, and support of living-learning communities, the CPC helps foster student belonging, engagement, intellectual curiosity, and holistic development.

The CPC supports the college pair and serves as a key stakeholder in developing and maintaining each college's College Model Plan, including goals, learning outcomes, traditions, signature experiences and events, and opportunities for student engagement.

Professional affiliation with a professional organization such as National Association of Student Personnel Administrators (NASPA), American College Personnel Association (ACPA), Association of College and University Housing Officers International (ACUHO-I), etc.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.

The University of California has implemented a Vaccination Policy covering all employees. Employees, including new hires, are required to comply with any applicable policies relating to the University of California vaccine program.

Per the Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act (CANRA), this position has been identified as a Mandated Reporter. The selected candidate will be required to report known or suspected child abuse or neglect as defined by CANRA and will be required to sign a Statement Acknowledging Requirement to Report Child Abuse prior to commencing employment. CANRA Penal Codes, and related definitions, requirements, and responsibilities may be obtained here.

Demonstrated excellent organizational and time management skills: ability to independently manage a variety of projects with frequent interruptions and shifting priorities, to organize a continuous flow of work in a timely manner and meet mandatory deadlines.
Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends as directed.
Excellent record keeping and organizational skills with ability to pay strict attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).
Demonstrated ability to interact harmoniously and cooperatively with students, staff, and faculty with a variety of background and socioeconomic backgrounds.
Strong computer skills with knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, database, page layout, graphic, e-mail and calendar applications; ability to work with Macintosh computer systems.
Ability to supervise student staff.
Ability to assimilate from oral and written sources a broad knowledge of campus and procedures and apply them with consistency.
